summary: Meshy's Free web-app plan grants 100 credits every month for its 3D-generation tools (text-to-3D, image-to-3D, AI texturing), resetting at 00:00 UTC on the first of each month. Free includes one concurrent task, low queue priority, and ten Meshy 6 Lite model downloads per month; API access is not included. No credit card required; free-plan outputs are licensed under CC BY 4.0 (commercial use allowed with attribution).
claim_steps: Sign up free at https://www.meshy.ai — no credit card required.
Receive 100 credits/month; credits reset at 00:00 UTC on the first day of each month.
Use the web app within the Free limits: one concurrent task, low queue priority, and ten Meshy 6 Lite model downloads/month. The Free plan does not include API access.
Free-plan outputs carry a CC BY 4.0 license (commercial use allowed with attribution).
